edits.text: PARTIES. This Share Purchase Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into by and between the Seller (the “Seller”) and Meridian Acquisitions LLC (the “Buyer”). Seller and Buyer are each a “Party” and together the “Parties.” The transaction-specific legal names, notice addresses, and the number and class of shares being sold (the “Shares”) shall be set forth on the signature page or an agreed schedule before execution.

1. PURCHASE AND SALE; PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, Seller shall sell, assign, transfer, and deliver the Shares to Buyer, and Buyer shall purchase the Shares from Seller, free and clear of all liens created by Seller. The aggregate purchase price is USD 8,000,000 (the “Purchase Price”), payable by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Seller at least two business days before Closing. The Purchase Price is the entire consideration payable for the Shares, subject only to any adjustment expressly agreed in a writing signed by both Parties. Each Party shall bear its own transaction expenses.

2. CLOSING. The closing of the purchase and sale (the “Closing”) shall take place remotely by exchange of signatures and closing deliverables no later than 30 calendar days after the date this Agreement is signed by both Parties, or on another date agreed in writing. At Closing, Seller shall deliver duly executed instruments transferring the Shares and any certificates representing them, if applicable, and Buyer shall pay the Purchase Price in accordance with Section 1. Each Party shall deliver the other customary closing certificates and documents reasonably necessary to effect the transaction.

3. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES. (a) Seller represents to Buyer, as of signing and as of Closing, that: (i) Seller has authority to enter into and perform this Agreement; (ii) this Agreement is binding on Seller, subject to customary bankruptcy and equitable-principles limitations; (iii) Seller owns the Shares and has the right to transfer them as provided herein, free of liens created by Seller; and (iv) to Seller’s knowledge, the financial statements previously provided by Seller to Buyer were prepared in good faith from the books and records of the business and are accurate in all material respects as of their stated dates. (b) Buyer represents to Seller, as of signing and as of Closing, that Buyer is duly organized, has authority to enter into and perform this Agreement, and has funds available to pay the Purchase Price. No representation or warranty is made except as expressly set forth in this Agreement. Any disclosure schedules agreed by the Parties and delivered before signing form part of this Agreement.

4. INDEMNIFICATION. (a) Subject to this Section, Seller shall indemnify Buyer for direct, documented losses finally determined to result from Seller’s breach of an express representation or warranty in Section 3 or Seller’s breach of a covenant in this Agreement. Buyer shall indemnify Seller for direct, documented losses finally determined to result from Buyer’s breach of an express representation or warranty or covenant in this Agreement. (b) A claim for breach of representation or warranty must be noticed in reasonable detail within 12 months after Closing; claims for breach of covenants survive until performed or, if applicable, for 12 months after Closing. No Party is liable for a claim unless aggregate covered losses exceed USD 50,000, and then only for losses above that amount. Seller’s aggregate liability for representation and warranty claims shall not exceed 10% of the Purchase Price. These limits do not apply to fraud or a Party’s intentional breach. (c) The indemnified Party shall give prompt written notice describing the claim and reasonably cooperate in its defense; delay in notice reduces liability only to the extent materially prejudiced. No Party may recover twice for the same loss, and neither Party is liable for punitive or consequential damages, except to the extent payable to a third party or arising from fraud or intentional breach. The indemnification provisions are the exclusive remedy for claims arising from this Agreement, except for fraud, intentional breach, or equitable relief.

5. CLOSING CONDITIONS. Each Party’s obligation to close is conditioned on the other Party’s material performance of its obligations due at Closing and the accuracy in all material respects of its representations and warranties as of Closing (subject, where applicable, to any express materiality qualification). Buyer’s obligation is also conditioned on receipt of the executed transfer instruments and any third-party or governmental consent required for the transfer of the Shares. Each Party shall use commercially reasonable efforts to satisfy conditions within its control before the Closing. A condition may be waived only in writing by the Party entitled to its benefit.

6. TERMINATION. This Agreement may be terminated by mutual written consent or by either Party if Closing has not occurred by the date 30 calendar days after signing, unless the terminating Party’s material breach caused the failure to close. Termination does not affect accrued rights or any provision that by its nature survives termination.

7. GENERAL. This Agreement, including any agreed disclosure schedules, is the entire agreement between the Parties concerning its subject matter and supersedes prior discussions on that subject. Any amendment or waiver must be in a writing signed by both Parties. Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the other Party’s written consent, except Buyer may assign it to an affiliate that assumes Buyer’s obligations, without releasing Buyer. Notices must be in writing and delivered to the addresses designated by the Parties on the signature page. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature. If any provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions remain in effect. The Parties shall cooperate in good faith to execute further documents reasonably necessary to carry out the transaction.

SIGNATURES. The Parties have executed this Agreement as of the dates set forth below. Seller: ____________________  By/Name/Title: ____________________  Date: __________  Notice address: ____________________. Buyer: Meridian Acquisitions LLC  By/Name/Title: ____________________  Date: __________  Notice address: ____________________.
